releases.summary: Major release: new authentication scheme and refund event semantics.
changes: BREAKING: authentication is now `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. The legacy `X-API-Key` header is no longer accepted.
BREAKING: `/charges` request field renamed from `amount_cents` to `amount`. The field still carries the smallest currency unit; only the name changed.
Added webhook event `payment.refunded` emitted whenever a refund completes.
Added webhook event `payment.disputed` for dispute lifecycle tracking.
